synthesis: Company Metrics LPR Repos is the lpr-repossessions card. The compact headline under the default this_month toggle is db_repos for the current UTC month bucket. That number comes from LprRepossessionsQuery, which reads clarity.billing_claim_events_v (is_internal = 0, event_type case-claim) and does not read clarity.orgs. The org id is auth()->user()->org_id, counted on either the forwarder or the agent side, then joined to a status-3 hotlist and a status-3 status-log row within claim_date - 7 days. Brad Webb's org id and the demo's exact UI count are not in the ticket or the repo. No Cloud measure was run.

card.heading: LPR Repossessions
not_the_headline: deduped (Unique LPR Case Claims reads that stage)
description line: N scans per LPR repo (RatioAgainstUniqueScans)

ui_path.this_month_total: DashboardWidget::getCardTotal uses the last bucket of getMonthlyData(formatted: false). last_month uses the previous bucket. today and last_7d use currentPeriodTotal().
ui_path.org_binding: auth()->user()->org_id. No org picker on this card. Impersonation changes the authenticated user.
ui_path.cache_ttl: Index 0 of the ladder: 10 minutes, or 10 seconds when session('admin_impersonator') is set. The series includes the open month, so the year arm is not used.
ui_path.sql_explainer: getCardQueryStatements returns monthlySeriesSql for this_month and last_month, and windowSql for today and last_7d. The note says the card reads the db_repos column.

query_path.reads_clarity_orgs_proof: The class docblock states it does not read clarity.orgs. The SQL body has no clarity.orgs token. rg hits only that docblock and the MV sentence about zod.public_orgs.
predicates: ts BETWEEN utc start epoch AND utc end epoch
event_date BETWEEN toDate(utc start) AND toDate(utc end)
query_path.month_window: monthlySeriesSql sets end to through UTC endOfMonth and start to that end minus 12 months, startOfMonth. through is now('UTC'). Bucket is toStartOfMonth(event_date).
query_path.dedup: BillingClaimDedup::dedupedCteSql groups claims where success and vin != '' by bucket, forwarder_org_id, agent_org_id, vin and takes min(claim_date). forwarder_org_id stays in the key.
query_path.hotlist_join: LEFT JOIN {zod}.public_hotlist FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND status = 3 ON org_id = agent_org_id AND vin, guarded by agent_org_id != 0
query_path.status_log_join: LEFT JOIN {zod}.public_hotlist_status_log WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 AND new_status = 3 AND toDate(created_at, 'UTC') >= {floor}. No FINAL. Guard h.id != 0. {floor} is the UTC window start minus 7 days.

billing_claim_events_v.body: SELECT listed columns FROM clarity.billing_claim_events FINAL WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0. Does not project _peerdb_is_deleted.

clarity_orgs.body: SELECT * FROM zod.public_orgs WHERE type IN (1, 2). No FINAL. Unused by LprRepossessionsQuery.

billing_claim_events_mv.is_internal: 1 when the normalized zod.public_orgs FINAL name of the forwarder or the agent contains insightlpr. All org types. Frozen at MV refresh.

either_side.recovery_join_is_agent_side: The hotlist match is h.org_id = d.agent_org_id. A row kept because the viewer is only the forwarder still counts when the agent org's hotlist recovered.
either_side.not_a_verdict: This is the shipped predicate. It is not evidence that the demo number is wrong.
